# EquityKey
EquityKey is a non-custodial benefit protocol for official Coinbase Tokenized Stocks on Base.
Live Mode reads official Base Mainnet B20 scaled balances. Demo Mode uses clearly labeled, valueless test tokens on Base Sepolia.
EquityKey does not trade stocks, provide investment advice, or take custody. Eligibility is enforced by smart contracts when a claim is made.
Source: https://github.com/fawazfff/equitykey
Official stock registry: https://www.base.org/stocks
